description_excerpt: Job Description About SGS Young Talent Program SGS Young Talent Program is a structured three-year development journey designed to build a sustainable pipeline of future frontline leaders. Through the Learn – Perform – Lead framework, participants will strengthen technical expertise, develop business acumen, and gradually build leadership capabilities to become future Supervisors and Team Leaders within SGS.
